name: Christmas Dinner Run
description: The village kitchen is short of everything for the big dinner. Fly a crate of food in before it goes cold.

name: Stocking Fillers
description: A crate of small gifts for the village stockings. Light, fragile and very much expected.

name: Coal for the Naughty List
description: Someone has to deliver it. A heavy crate of ore for the village smithy, and a few lumps of coal for the stockings of the naughty.

name: Toy Workshop Parts
description: A pallet of gears and mechanisms for a village toymaker who cannot keep up with the orders.

name: North Pole Bakery Boiler
description: The bakery boiler gave out in the cold. Haul a new one in so the gingerbread ovens can run again.

name: [special] Santa's Sleigh Manifest
description: The locked container holds the whole list: every name, every present. Heavy, precious and only for trusted pilots.

name: [special] Midnight Present Drop
description: Christmas Eve, after dark. A full pallet of presents has to reach the far village before morning.
